title: davishiggins.com
summary: A motion-led personal home connecting projects, experience, writing, and contact.
tagline: The central public home for my professional identity and project ecosystem: an editorial, highly interactive site that organizes work across data, AI, analytics, web development, and design.
role: Designed and built the site, its content layer, its interaction system, and the presentation of the wider project ecosystem.
problem: A broad mix of data, AI, web, and creative work needs a coherent public identity. Without a clear structure, a visitor sees a list of unrelated links instead of one body of work.
contribution: I designed and developed the site, from its content model and Work system to its motion design, and I maintain the destinations it connects.
solution: The site combines recruiter-facing information, categorized project discovery, current experience, writing, and direct contact paths. A structured Work system presents each project by category, status, purpose, technology, and destination.
solutionPoints: A Work system organized by category and development status.
Current positions, focus, and verified accomplishments in one place.
Custom motion: smooth scrolling, animated transitions, cursor effects, and a contrast toggle.
A document-icon resume link that opens the PDF directly, the same pattern this portfolio now uses.

architecture.summary: Shared content is kept separate from presentation, with one token system for color, contrast, and responsive behavior.

decisions.title: Separate content from presentation.
decisions.text: Project and experience data live in one place, so a change appears everywhere it is used.

decisions.title: One token system.
decisions.text: Color, contrast, and spacing come from shared tokens, which keeps the contrast toggle and responsive layouts consistent.

decisions.title: Keep destinations consistent.
decisions.text: Every project link points to the same verified destination used across my other sites.

outcomes: davishiggins.com is live as the hub that connects this portfolio, Curated Notes, Higgins Digital, and individual project sites.
limits: The public DavisHiggins/Portfolio repository is a showcase of this main site, not the source of this conversational portfolio.
lessons: A broad project ecosystem becomes easier to understand when identity, content, and destinations share one structure.
